title: Evening scratch: devx doc gaps & sample app tasks
content:
Date: 2026-03-13
Context: quick evening brain-dump after pairing w/ Maya on the onboarding sample app. Goal: capture immediate TODOs, triage order, and tiny implementation notes so I don’t forget tomorrow. Mostly short bullets, estimates, and quick repro steps.

Top-level goals
- Make a tiny, friction-free sample app that demonstrates: hosted API auth flow, client-side streaming consumption, and local replay for tests.
- Reduce the number of steps in the Quickstart from 7 -> 3 for JS users.
- Close 3 doc gaps called out by SRE and Solutions Eng.

Open issues + rough priority (P1 = block for tutorial launch)
1) P1: Streaming example in quickstart missing event-based consumer snippet
   - problem: current snippet shows fetch + text() which loses incremental tokens.
   - proposed: add plain-EventSource & WebSocket mini example and a Node fetch-stream consumer.
   - quick code sketch to include (node-run):
     // pseudocode to explain intent
     const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST' });
     for await (const chunk of res.body) { processChunk(chunk); }
   - estimate: 1.5h to write, 0.5h to test in playground.
   - blockers: need a stable hosted endpoint that streams in the staging project (ask infra: DEVS-4123).

2) P1: Local dev guide for Private/VPC sample app is inconsistent
   - notes: VPN + KMS steps are scattered across private-deployments docs. Users hit 401s when using local creds flow.
   - quick fix: add a single troubleshooting section in sample README: env var order, KMS key alias, and a curl example that validates the token.
   - estimate: 1h.

3) P2: Sample app uses deprecated SDK method names (sdk.client.generate -> sdk.text.generate)
   - need to update snippets and run linters through the docs repo.
   - create a small migration note for older users.
   - estimate: 0.5h to update snippets + 0.5h CI run.

4) P2: Missing reranking example in the embedding cookbook
   - request from Solutions Eng in call at 10:30. They want 6-line example: compute embeddings -> score candidates -> return top-K.
   - plan: paste an end-to-end JS snippet using the embeddings endpoint + simple cosine function.
   - estimate: 1.0h.

Micro-tasks (can batch)
- [ ] Add EventSource streaming example to quickstart (file: docs/quickstart/js/streaming.md) — tag: streaming-sample
- [ ] Consolidate Private deploy troubleshooting into sample README — tag: private-local
- [ ] Replace deprecated method calls across sdk examples (grep + sed, docs repo) — tag: sdk-migration
- [ ] Draft short migration note for changelog.md — tag: changelog
- [ ] Small reranking example for cookbook — tag: embeddings-rerank
- [ ] Add 'how to replay a request locally' section (usecase: flaky prod vs local debug) — tag: replay-local

Notes from pairing with Maya
- Keep the quickstart runnable in browser (no server required). That means we need a tiny proxy pattern in the repo (serverless function) that hides the API key, but also include explicit warning about not using that in prod.
- Suggestion: make streaming example use a light-weight JSONL replay file in the repo so users can try streaming without a real model call. Add npm script `npm run replay` that pipes the JSONL into the page.

Testing matrix (manual)
- Browser quickstart: Chrome, Firefox — streaming check, button-based demo.
- Node quickstart: node 18 LTS — streaming consumer + replay CLI.
- Private: local Docker compose with mock KMS + small certs — check auth flow.

Stumbling blocks / unresolved
- Need confirmation from infra if staging streaming endpoint supports chunked responses with SSE. (Ping: @infra-team)
- Should the sample app demonstrate function calling? pros/cons: adds complexity but is a real-world pattern. Maybe make it an optional "advanced" section.

Small UX copy I want to use (draft)
- "Run the demo in your browser. No backend required — we provide a safe replay mode so you can try streaming without billing or keys."
- "Tip: if you get a 401 on private mode, check your KMS alias and RUN_ORDER of env vars (auth token must be derived after KMS is unlocked)."

Quick next steps (tomorrow)
1. Draft streaming snippet + replay JSONL (blocker check with infra) — 2h
2. Update 6 small snippets for deprecated SDK names — 1h
3. Merge a short README patch for private local dev — 45m
4. Ask Solutions Eng for candidate query + label set for reranking example — message in Slack thread

Misc scratch ideas to capture (may extract later)
- Small "playground generator" that creates a minimal sample app from user choices (streaming on/off, private/public) — could be a tiny service or a CLI flag in the sample generator.
- Add a one-page cheat sheet with three copy/paste examples: simple generation, streaming, embeddings->rerank. Keep each <= 8 lines.

References/links to keep handy
- PR where we updated auth flow last time: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/432
- Docs PR to watch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789
- Jira: DEVS-4123 (streaming staging support)
- Slack thread: #devx: doc-sample-issues (search: "replay jsonl")

End of scratch. Will tidy & move items into the docs repo tomorrow morning.

Signature: Rina
